0022600109.text: The Mavericks (1-1, 3rd in the Southwest and 9th in the West) host the Spurs (0-2, 5th in the Southwest and 12th in the West), with this being Dallas's third game of the season. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 139-120 Mavericks loss in San Antonio on April 10, 2026, which was part of a 2025-26 season series Dallas lost 0-4. Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (shoulder soreness) and Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), and Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and has Tobias Harris listed as day-to-day with a calf strain.
